transcript: Living room lighting upgrade for Marcus Vance at 1442 West End Court. Installed six 6-inch LED wafer lights across the ceiling. Added one Lutron smart dimmer switch that we supplied for sixty-five dollars. Labor took three hours... well actually three and a half hours because fishing wire through the old plaster joists was tricky. Need to bill fifty feet of 14/2 Romex cable, not in our standard rates.

expected.job_summary: Living room recessed LED lighting and dimmer install
expected.notes: Tricky wire fishing through old plaster ceiling.
